name: Iron Maiden Trap AP OLD
description: A pressure plate hidden on the floor before an iron maiden causes the torture device to snap shut and trap the triggering creature inside.
disable: DC 28 Thievery to disable the pressure plate
reset: The pressure plate must be reset manually.

generalAbilities.name: Slam Shut
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature steps onto the trap's pressure plate (indicated on the map)

Effect The front of the iron maiden slams shut with incredible force and locks itself. The triggering creature takes (4d10+10) Piercing Damage]{4d10+10 piercing damage and 2d6 persistent bleed damage} (Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw save; if the creature critically succeeds, they avoid the trap completely). The triggering creature is also Immobilized. The victim can end their immobilization only once a creature outside the iron maiden unlocks the device (requiring two successful DC 28 Thievery checks to Disable device dc=28) or breaks the iron maiden, after which the trapped creature must succeed at a DC 25 check to Escape dc=25 the trap's spike-lined interior.

hp.note: Iron Maiden Hardness 12; Iron Maiden HP 46 (BT 23)
